proofCeiling: The registry defines source binding, local artifact ownership, names, validator isolation and proof limits. Server-start evidence can prove only the bounded foreground start/status/stop lifecycle of the exact verified binary; artifact presence alone never proves installation approval, client attach, detach/reattach, background persistence, agent state, sprint success or runtime promotion.
